releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.205: Fixes Home Screen Widget shortcut routing by assigning each button a unique Android PendingIntent action and widget/slot/target URI. Private Locker, Favourite Notes, and World Clock now have isolated tap identities; the other seven shortcuts, selected-button layout, date toggle, 3D feedback, and resize behavior are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
